metadata.title: MAPP 4512.2 Rev.2 Conducting Effective Meetings in CDER: Remote Access Considerations
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.

candidates.statement: BACKGROUND CDER staff must perform essential functions at all times, including during emergencies and Continuity of Operations Program (COOP) events. Specific tools and technologies are identified to ensure productivity, efficiency, and access to information from any location.
candidates.context: This MAPP outlines procedures and responsibilities of all meeting participants, to ensure CDER meetings are effective when participants are working from remote locations. Available tools and technology are tailored to match the meeting’s structure and objectives. Meeting host(s) may obtain support from FDA’s Office of Digital Transformation (ODT) Office of Information Management Technology (OIMT).

candidates.statement: • At the start of the meeting, announce the following: o Participants should mute their telephones or microphone.
candidates.context: • Ensure that telephone and auxiliary microphones are optimally placed to maximize their effectiveness, and minimize the impact of other sound sources, such as projector fans. o Speakers should speak clearly and audibly into microphones. o Meeting participants should state their names when offering comments or questions.

candidates.statement: o Speakers should speak clearly and audibly into microphones. o Meeting participants should state their names when offering comments or questions.
candidates.context: • At the start of the meeting, announce the following: o Participants should mute their telephones or microphone. o Instruct remote participants on the preferred method to submit questions or comments for this meeting.

candidates.statement: o Host or speakers should restate questions to ensure remote attendees can hear the entire question.
candidates.context: o Instruct remote participants on the preferred method to submit questions or comments for this meeting. o Discourage sidebar conversations. Remote Meeting Participants • Participate in web conferencing training in advance of work-related web conferencing, to ensure knowledge of how to ensure visual and audio connections, chat features, mute button, headsets, and cameras.

candidates.statement: PROCEDURES Setting Up a Meeting • Meeting host(s) obtain an individual web conferencing account. Note: CDER managers, project managers, and others who routinely host web conferences should be trained in web conference tools.
candidates.context: FDA OIMT • Provide training for current and upcoming web conferencing tools. • Meeting host shares the dial-in phone number, username and password requirements, web conference link, meeting agenda, and other meeting documents at least one day in advance of the meeting.
